description:
After failing to ascend, Mu-hwa, an imugi, lives on as Mu-sanghyeonsa, the village’s guardian deity. One day, an utterly unnecessary bride is offered to him. The groom(?) Jin-yo is far too sturdy by any measure and seems to be approaching with some kind of ulterior motive.

*“Is tonight our first night…?”*

Regardless of Mu-hwa’s wish to help him recuperate in body and mind and then send him back, the so-called bride looks fully intent on settling in for good…!

---
